title: Frame-time history and a sparkline
description:
Build `FrameHistory`, which keeps the last `capacity` frame times (milliseconds) for the stats panel.

- `push(ms)` adds a sample, dropping the oldest when full.
- `min()`, `max()`, `average()` over the stored samples (0 when empty).
- `sparkline()` returns one character per sample, oldest first, chosen from the eight levels `" ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█"` without the space, that is the characters `▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█` (as UTF-8 strings). The tallest bar (`█`) is the maximum; a sample `v` gets level `round(7 * v / max)`, from 0 (`▁`) to 7 (`█`). If the maximum is 0, every sample is `▁`. Return the characters joined into one UTF-8 `std::string`.

```
push 8, 8, 16, 8   ->  min 8, max 16, average 10
sparkline = "▅▅█▅"    (7 * 8 / 16 = 3.5, rounds to 4: ▅)
```
hints: Keep the samples in a vector, erasing the first when it grows past the capacity. `std::min_element`, `std::max_element` and `std::accumulate` give the statistics.
Store the eight bar characters as UTF-8 string literals (`"▁"` to `"█"`) in an array, and append the one at index `lround(7 * v / max)`.
lessonTitle: A Live Stats Panel for Your Game
